variety_description: An average yielding, medium maturity, medium tall, long slender variety suitable for cultivation across country under rainfed lowland growing conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2017 for planting in Aman season. Aromatic premium quality rice for export with high grain weight.  Susceptible to major diseases and insect pests.
